What you need to know
Tick each one you know.
Modulus: a is the size of a without its sign. −4 = 4 = 4, and a modulus is never negative.
Key rule: A = k, with k ≥ 0, means A = k or A = −k.
x on the right: in A = B, the right side B must be ≥ 0. Check every answer.
Graph: y = f(x) reflects the part of y = f(x) below the x-axis up above it.
